evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics within two hours are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No realised money-weighted NET P&L by strategy, chain, asset, route and notional after every fee and failed-attempt cost.
No opportunity-level counterfactual outcomes for accepted and rejected signals, preventing selection-bias analysis.
No Solana contemporaneous executable entry/exit edge, priority-fee, price-impact, sellability and route-decay dataset.
No EVM predicted-versus-realised gas, revert, inclusion, slippage and price-impact error distribution by chain and route.
No structured attribution separating STRATEGY/MARKET adverse movement from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No out-of-sample or walk-forward results, confidence intervals, drawdown, capital exposure, turnover or tail-loss evidence.

Before any promotion: require fresh reconciled realised outcomes, chain-specific cost coverage, execution-success and failure-stage telemetry, sufficient independent observation windows, positive out-of-sample money-weighted net P&L, acceptable drawdown/tail loss, and confirmation that all existing safety gates remain enforced.

proposals.downside_risk: Schema complexity and possible double-counting if already-net values are decomposed without reconciliation invariants.

evidence.detail: Windows store aggregate profit, fees, slippage and execution failures but no denomination, gas/priority fee, price-impact, failure stage or capital exposure fields.
Realised net is recorded as gross profit or gross loss with fees and slippage left at zero, losing the decomposition needed for chain-specific diagnosis.
Execution failures are counted separately, but realised results retain no structured cause taxonomy.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents promotion or replacement decisions based on incomparable or opaque net totals and makes chain-specific loss attribution auditable.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 reconciled outcomes per chain and strategy family across at least 7 independent daily windows, including at least 5 failed or rejected execution attempts where available.
proposals.rationale: Durable money-weighted evaluation requires consistent denomination and explicit decomposition of market return, DEX/platform fees, slippage, price impact, EVM gas or Solana priority/base fees, refundable rent, failed-attempt cost and execution outcome. A negative result caused by adverse post-entry movement is STRATEGY/MARKET loss; quote expiry, revert, dropped transaction, RPC failure or unplanned execution cost is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
proposals.shadow_test: For every SHADOW outcome, reconcile gross proceeds minus acquisition cost, all explicit fees, slippage/impact, failed-attempt costs and non-refundable execution costs to recorded net within one smallest accounting unit. Stop the test if any component is missing, denomination is unknown, or reconciliation differs.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote-only results can overstate achievable performance because route decay, contention and inclusion failures are not fills.

evidence.detail: Solana leader observations deliberately set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity and sellability to zero because no contemporaneous executable future-return quote exists.
The scorecard explicitly reports solana_current_quote_edge_adapter as an evidence gap.
Common eligibility requires positive net edge, liquidity, sellability and quote freshness, so current Solana observations correctly remain ineligible.

proposals.expected_effect: Creates falsifiable Solana evidence while preserving abstention when executable edge is absent.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible and ineligible observations over 14 days, with at least 30 complete round-trip shadow outcomes and results segmented by liquidity, size and route.
proposals.rationale: Solana strategy evaluation currently measures scan coverage rather than executable economics. A SHADOW adapter should capture size-matched entry and exit quotes, base and priority fees, price impact, slippage reserve, quote age, sellability, route availability and subsequent mark-out without submitting transactions.
proposals.shadow_test: At signal time record size-matched round-trip quotes and all Solana costs, then re-quote at the intended submission and exit horizons. Classify adverse mark-out as STRATEGY/MARKET and quote/API/RPC/route failure as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Fail the hypothesis if realised-style shadow net is non-positive after all costs or if quote-to-outcome coverage falls below 90%.

proposals.downside_risk: Over-segmentation can create sparse samples and thresholds fitted to transient regimes.

evidence.detail: Common minimum net-edge and quote-age thresholds are fixed basis-point constants shared across chain types.
EVM costs are converted to basis points from estimated gas, builder fee and slippage, with optional price-impact and latency reserves.
EVM direct-market execution separately requires estimated net profit to clear a multiple of gas, providing a useful additional economic guard.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces false-positive trades whose quoted edge is consumed by chain-specific uncertainty without increasing trade frequency as an objective.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 timestamped opportunities per chain across 14 days, at least 30 complete executable outcomes per tested route/liquidity bucket, and bootstrap confidence intervals for net P&L and worst-decile shortfall.
proposals.rationale: A fixed 4–6 bps predicted margin may be adequate for neither chain under volatile costs. Thresholds should be learned only from out-of-sample prediction error and execution shortfall, independently by chain, route, notional and liquidity regime, while retaining a strictly positive conservative edge.
proposals.shadow_test: Compare existing fixed thresholds with conservative chain-specific thresholds equal to estimated costs plus an upper-confidence execution-shortfall reserve. Include rejected opportunities as counterfactual observations. Reject the change if out-of-sample money-weighted net does not improve, tail loss worsens, or coverage is insufficient.
proposals.strategy: Cross Venue Net Arbitrage and related executable-edge strategies

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower positive-edge, liquidity or sellability thresholds to force more trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: Trade count is not the objective, and no runtime evidence shows that marginal opportunities remain profitable after executable costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote strategies from positive quote-simulation totals or raw win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: The repository correctly labels quote simulations as non-realised evidence; neither simulated totals nor win count establishes durable money-weighted net P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Replace inactive strategies solely because they produced no trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: No eligible market setup is not evidence of strategy failure, and the Strategy Lab already preserves this distinction.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository correctly defaults missing features to fail-closed values, keeps new strategies in SHADOW, requires positive estimated executable edge, and separates simulated quotes from promotion evidence. However, there is no fresh runtime evidence, Solana lacks a current executable-edge feature adapter, and lifecycle accounting does not preserve sufficient cost and failure attribution to distinguish STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. Profitability, CANARY readiness and LIVE readiness cannot be claimed.
